=== growth targets notes (first 100 lines) ===
# X Growth Targets — PING Social audience growth
Researched 2026-09-25. Every handle verified through public web evidence (source noted).
Confidence: STRONG = direct handle citation from first-party or current profile mirror, activity within ~30 days where confirmed. MEDIUM = direct handle citation from a reliable third party but current posting cadence not directly confirmed.
Rule: skip franchises/chains/mega-celebrities/obvious bots. Prefer owner-operated shops and 200-20,000 follower accounts.

## Bucket 1: Independent home-service trade businesses (9)

1. RealTommyMello — STRONG — Tommy Mello (A1 Garage Doors); large home-service founder voice; explicit X URL in a home-service interview crawled ~2 days ago; comment/quote-post target (low follow-back odds, high visibility).
2. AizikZimerman — STRONG — CEO of J. Blanton Plumbing, $6M to $36M growth, ~3K followers; posts long X threads on plumbing economics, AI strategy, and global staffing; engaged trade operator, reply-likely.
3. WilsonCompanies — STRONG — John Wilson, plumber from Akron building a $100M home service company in public, ~38K followers; host of @OwnedxOperated; engaged trade journey account, comment-rich.
4. thehvacjack — STRONG — Jack Carr, buying/building a home-services company in Middle TN, ex-emu farmer, ~7K followers; co-host @ownedoperatedco; owner-operator in growth mode, follow-back plausible.
5. tone2k18 — STRONG — Veton Hashani, residential HVAC in Atlanta, "$5M first full year, $10M this year or bust", ~1K followers; active small trade owner, high reply/follow-back odds.
6. GoldMedalServes — MEDIUM — Gold Medal Service (East Brunswick NJ), the $28-32M home-services company Mike Agugliaro built and exited; handle from business directory; good comment surface on legacy trade content.
7. NexstarNetwork — STRONG — member-owned org for independent plumbing/HVAC/electrical contractors, ~969 followers; explicit X URL in press coverage; peer network of exactly PING's buyers.
8. Goettlceo — MEDIUM — Goettl (AZ HVAC) leadership voice; handle from home-services podcast reference; strong industry fit but current activity needs a live check before heavy spend.
9. servicechampsS — MEDIUM — Service Champions HVAC; handle from home-services podcast reference; same caveat as Goettlceo: verify live activity first.

## Bucket 2: Western Slope Colorado local businesses (15)

1. GJChamber — MEDIUM — Grand Junction Area Chamber of Commerce; indexed public content names it as the chamber account; local business hub, follow-back likely if engaged.
2. GJCity — STRONG — City of Grand Junction official; current posts about 2026 community events visible in profile mirror; civic anchor, comment surface on local issues.
3. VisitGJ — STRONG — Visit Grand Junction DMO, ~4K followers; official handle in 2018 press release, still current in profile mirrors; tourism voice, engaged regional audience.
4. GJEconDev — STRONG — Grand Junction Economic Partnership; "Follow us on Twitter: GJEconDev" in GJEP brochure; economic-development audience overlaps PING's buyer base.
5. ColoradoMesaU — STRONG — Colorado Mesa University, ~10K followers; seen in current profile mirrors; biggest local institution, high-visibility comment surface.
6. MesaCountyNews — STRONG — Mesa County government, ~5K followers; local-news adjacent, follow-back friendly.
7. DailySentinelGJ — STRONG — The Daily Sentinel (Western Colorado's largest newspaper since 1893), ~7K followers; news voice, good for quote-commenting on local business stories.
8. KJCTNews8 — STRONG — KJCT News 8 Grand Junction, ~7K followers; asks for story tips, reply-friendly.
9. KKCO11News — STRONG — KKCO 11 News Grand Junction, ~7K followers; same pattern as KJCT.
10. GrandJunctionPD — STRONG — Grand Junction Police Department, ~6K followers; very active community account; local goodwill surface.
11. NWSGJT — STRONG — National Weather Service Grand Junction, ~11K followers; high-engagement weather content; weather ties to trades (HVAC demand), good contextual comment surface.
12. GJAirport — MEDIUM — Grand Junction Regional Airport; handle from airport directory page; verify current activity on first pass.
13. KannahCreekBrew — STRONG — Kannah Creek Brewing Co (Grand Junction), voted #1 brewery in Grand Junction; handle from brewery press; beloved local brand, engaged followers.
14. palisadebrewco — STRONG — Palisade Brewing Company, 200 Peach Ave Palisade; handle from Untappd venue record; Dirty Hippie dark wheat fans, local institution.
15. 881Kafm — STRONG — KAFM 88.1 community radio, "The Voice of Our Community", Grand Junction; handle from radio directories; community-engaged audience.

## Bucket 3: SMB AI/automation and home-service industry voices (9)

1. workizinc — STRONG — Workiz; official X URL in 2026 YouTube video descriptions; current topics: AI answering, missed-call capture, HVAC/plumbing automation; PING-adjacent product voice.
2. ServiceTitan — STRONG — ServiceTitan; profile and current posts visible in profile mirror crawled ~4 days ago; trades + AI + contractor operations; marquee comment surface.
3. GetJobber — STRONG — Jobber; @GetJobber confirmed across official material; home-service SMB software voice.
4. housecallpro — STRONG — Housecall Pro; official twitter.com/housecallpro link; home-service software voice.
5. dESCO_FieldEdge — MEDIUM — FieldEdge field-service software; Twitter URL from Inc.com profile (legacy dESCO handle); trade-software voice, verify it is still the active handle on first pass.
6. contractormag — STRONG — Contractor Magazine; profile mirror shows plumbing/HVAC trade publication with active 2026 AI-search coverage; industry media voice.
7. ownedoperatedco — STRONG — Owned and Operated podcast (home-service business growth, John Wilson + Jack Carr); official handle across YouTube/podcast pages; note: profile mirror also shows @OwnedxOperated (~4K) as an alternate/branded handle.
8. boringlocalseo — STRONG — local-SEO voice, ~9K followers, "bugs you w/ local seo sauce to make more money"; exactly the SMB marketing pain PING speaks to; reply-likely.
9. EllenRohr — MEDIUM — Ellen Rohr, contractor finance/business coach; handle confirmed across first- and third-party sources with 2026 podcast relevance; verify current X posting cadence on first pass.

## Bucket 4: Engaged small-business owners likely to reply or follow back (13)

1. StrongpointRich — STRONG — Rich Jordan, ex-Marine officer, grew High Ground (plumbing/HVAC/electrical) $1M to $30M in 5 yrs, now Strongpoint Talent, ~19K followers; posts trades-growth threads, DM-friendly.
2. SamtLeslie — STRONG — Sam Leslie, owner of Mesa Plumbing-HVAC, host of Business Therapy podcast, ~12K followers; posts phone number, mailing-list CTA; explicitly engagement-seeking, high follow-back odds.
3. SMB_ChrisH — STRONG — Army veteran turned Wall Street turned HVAC business owner, UNC MBA, "Exploring AI daily", ~349 followers; PING-perfect persona overlap, very likely to reply.
4. BrockHBriggs — STRONG — host of the Scuttlebutt Podcast (service members building in the SMB space); handle from show's official site; SMB-entry audience.
5. j_adesoye — STRONG — Jide Adesoye (@withkumo_), ~4K followers, threads on buying/selling/operating businesses; SMB operator voice, engaged.
6. ClintFiore — STRONG — CEO of Dealonomy, ~65K followers, posts small-business buying/selling info, "DMs are OPEN" adjacent culture; engaged deal community.
7. BuySellSMB — STRONG — Will Fry, ~21K followers, "tackling Main Street's succession crisis", buys SMBs, turns operators into owners; engaged mission-driven audience.
8. SMB_Attorney — STRONG — Eric Pacifici, SMB M&A attorney, ~140K+ followers, $1.5B+ in SMB deals since 2022; deal-flow audience overlaps future PING buyers.
9. thesamparr — STRONG — Sam Parr, Hampton founders, My First Million, ~350K+ followers; big reach, engaged founder audience; comment target.
10. sweatystartup — STRONG — Nick Huber, ~400K+ followers, buys/starts blue-collar and boring businesses; engaged SMB audience; comment target.
11. PatrickDichter — STRONG — acquired 3 firms, bookkeeping/tax for SMBs, ~18K followers, NH and CO footprint; small-business geek, reply-likely.
12. NickMolinaETA — STRONG — started/built/sold 6 companies, now buys small/medium businesses (ETA), ~879 followers; small engaged operator account.
13. Evanstbe — STRONG — Tyler Evans, So-Cal business broker, ~4K followers, tweets SMB ops/ETA/biz acquisitions; engaged small-biz thread culture.

Confidence: STRONG = handle + recent on-X activity confirmed; MEDIUM = handle/identity confirmed, last-30-day post not directly observed. Caveats noted inline.

### Bucket 1: independent home-service trades (13, all MEDIUM)
roofinginsights (Dmitry Lipinskiy, Roofing Insights podcast), hvacknowitall (Gary McCreadie, HVAC Know It All podcast), ChadMPeterman (Peterman Brothers HVAC/plumbing/electrical), JoeCrisara (Service MVP, trade sales coach), DanLeibrandt (Pest Control Legends podcast; caveat: some sources use @DannyLeibrandt, verify live handle before following), ServiceBizPodcast (Service Business Mastery, Tersh Blissett), HVACShopTalk (Zack Psioda), walls_jason1 (Jason Walls, electrician/app builder), climateexperts1 (Derek Cormier, Climate Experts veteran-owned HVAC), badgerturf (Jonas Olson, Pest Badger; may be low-activity), RidgelineDoorCo (Van Brophy, garage door), eazylift (EazyLift Garage Door Co), pestgeekpodcast (Franklin Hernandez, Pest Geek Podcast).

### Bucket 2: Western Slope Colorado local (10, all MEDIUM)
dcinewspaper (Delta County Independent, Delta), soprissun (The Sopris Sun, Carbondale), SheriffMesaColo (Mesa County Sheriff), downtowngj (Downtown Grand Junction DDA), montrosegov (City of Montrose), highcountrynews (High Country News, Paonia), skipowderhorn (Powderhorn Mountain Resort, Mesa), rockslidebrew (Rockslide Brew Pub, GJ), TheCitizenTeleg (Rifle Citizen Telegram), newsy_cass (Cassandra Knust, KVNF journalist; individual, not org).

### Bucket 3: SMB AI/automation + trade industry voices (10: 2 STRONG, 8 MEDIUM)
PodiumHQ (STRONG, Podium AI lead conversion), JoyanneHawkins (STRONG, Sterling Sky local SEO), CallRail, brightlocal, gohighlevel, ServiceM8, HVACRSchool, accausa (ACCA trade association), acservicetech (Craig Migliaccio, held out of bucket 1 for size, included here), thenewflatrate.

### Bucket 4: engaged SMB owners (13: 4 STRONG, 9 MEDIUM)
awilkinson (STRONG, Andrew Wilkinson, Tiny), arvidkahl (STRONG, bootstrapper/author), tylertringas (STRONG, Calm Company Fund), mijustin (STRONG, Transistor), girdley, BrentBeshore, mhp_guy (Chris Koerner), walkerdeibel, DBarnettMoncton, markdaoust, acechapman, steli, brennandunn. Dropped: Bill D'Alessandro / Ryan Tansom / Carl Allen (handles unconfirmable in search).
